question: Does a lab SNOMED graph improve the lab tower?
decision_rule: Choose configuration by validation AUROC then report test once; repeat across seeds and use paired patient bootstrap for uncertainty
limitations: Additive variant was examined after seeing gated test results; single seed cannot establish generalization

question: Does a diagnosis SNOMED graph improve the diagnosis tower?
decision_rule: Choose by validation AUROC then report test once; repeat across seeds and use paired patient bootstrap for uncertainty
limitations: Single seed and no controlled graph ablation yet

question: Does lab fusion choice matter?
decision_rule: Compare gate against add with identical preprocessing and repeated seeds
limitations: Training randomness and more parameters can confound differences

question: Are test differences distinguishable from sampling variation?
decision_rule: Paired bootstrap by patient; CI is descriptive because variants have already been inspected on test
limitations: CI does not address training-seed uncertainty or model selection on test

question: Does true graph content matter beyond capacity and randomness?
comparison: lab KG shuffled/rewired; diagnosis KG rewired; KG removed
decision_rule: Predefine content and time ablations; select on validation before final locked test evaluation
limitations: Requires additional builds and GPU runs

question: Are results stable across training seeds?
secondary_metrics: mean and SD of test AUROC; paired deltas
decision_rule: Run at least three predeclared seeds for each model and summarize paired differences
limitations: Changing seed without a new test set cannot undo earlier test inspection
